PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Fire Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fire Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fire Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fire Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fire Safety.

2. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

5. When learning Visual Programming, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming.

6. When learning Plain Scale Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plain Scale Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plain Scale Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plain Scale Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Plain Scale Drawing.

7. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

8. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Safety.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Software.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Visual Programming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ceramic Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
